subject: Thanks for your interest in Contoso, Alex!
why: ack subject over a decline body; 'decision to not move forward FOR your application' is the same sentence as 'not moving forward with', and the ack rules must not outrank it
body:
Hi Alex,

Thank you for your application to Contoso!

After reviewing your skills and experience, we have made the decision to not move forward for your application for the Senior Software Engineer - Backend position at this time.

Please feel free to check our careers page, we are always updating our website with new opportunities.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best of luck in your search!

Warm regards,
Contoso Talent Acquisition

subject: 23 new openings - check for Software Engineer roles

body: Companies actively hiring near you. See new open roles this month and apply now. Interview tips that land dream roles.

subject: Thank you for applying to Contoso
why: a receipt whose only reject cue is a sign-off pleasantry stays a receipt. Tightening the ack branch to outrank a weak reject score filed five real confirmations as rejections
body: Thank you for applying to Contoso. We have received your application for the Backend Engineer role and our recruiting team will review it shortly. Unfortunately, due to the volume of interest we cannot reply to every candidate individually. We wish you the best of luck in your job search!

subject: Thank you for applying to Contoso
why: a receipt, not an invitation: the call is offered only if the application is a good fit. The condition and the advancement are 96 characters apart, and the guard used to reach back only 40, so this was published as a first interview
body:
Hi Alex,

Thank you for your application!

What happens next?

A member of our Talent Team will review your application as soon as possible.

If your application is a good fit for the position, one of our team members will contact you to schedule a call.

Thank you,
The Contoso Talent Team

subject: We received your application
why: 'If it aligns' drops the subject of the condition, so the conditional cue missed it and the promise to 'reach out to schedule an interview' scored as an offer. They rejected the applicant six days later
body:
Hi Alex,

We have your application and we're looking forward to reviewing it in detail. If it aligns with what we're looking for, we'll reach out to schedule an interview.

Thanks,
The Northwind Team

subject: Thanks for your interest in Fabrikam

body:

subject: Bid Form-Intermediate AI Engineer-Contoso

body:

subject: Thank you for your application!
why: a receipt whose only decision-shaped sentence is a legend for the careers dashboard: 'if you see the job moved to an inactive state, that means ... you were not selected'. Reject scoring was unguarded, so that hypothetical scored 10 and published a rejection that never happened
body:
Hi Alex,

Thank you for taking the time to submit your application for Senior Software Engineer - Data Integration (Job number: 200036142). We're glad you're interested in a career at Contoso.

You may not receive feedback from us on your application directly, but please know that it's being evaluated, and you'll hear from us as soon as the review process is complete. If you're selected for an interview, you'll be notified by the recruiting team.

Updates regarding your application status can be viewed through your Action Center. If you see the job moved to an inactive state, that means the position is either no longer open, you withdrew from consideration, or you were not selected for the role.

Thank you,
Contoso Recruiting

subject: Thank you for applying to Contoso Inc.
why: a receipt that walks through the whole hiring pipeline. Every stage in it is hypothetical - conditional on a match, described about candidates in general, or something the process *may* include - yet 'Technical Interview' and the 'Next Steps' heading scored 15 and published it as a first interview
body:
Hi Alex,

Thanks so much for applying-we really appreciate your interest in joining our team!

Here's a quick look at what you can expect next:

Application Review: Our hiring team will carefully review your application and any supporting documents
First Contact: If your background looks like a good match, we'll reach out to schedule an introductory chat with our Talent Team.
Next Steps: From there, successful candidates move on to a video interview with the hiring team. For Engineering roles, this may also include a Technical Interview. Depending on the position, you might be asked to complete a skills test and meet with our leadership team
Final Step: Before we make an offer, we'll run background checks.

We'll be in touch if we'd like to move forward with your application. Thanks again for considering a career with us!

Best,

Contoso Talent Team

subject: Applied for EI? Now set up your Job Bank account
why: an unemployment-benefits mail telling you to register on the state job board. No employer, no application, no decision - but it says next step, jobs, applications and resume, so every job-context check waves it through and 'next step' alone scored it as an interview invitation
body:
Hello,

Your next step after applying for Employment Insurance (EI) is to set up your Job Bank account.

To help you look for work, we will alert you to new jobs.

Connect with employers faster - submit applications in just a few clicks
Get matched with jobs - create your profile and let employers find you
Build or upload your resume
Stay organized - keep everything in one place (resumes, applications, alerts)

You'll also receive job alerts based on your last occupation.

Thank you,
Job Bank
